title: Colimits in Oriented Category Theory
summary: In higher category theory, lax colimits are often understood to be a more useful and powerful generalization of usual (homotopy) colimits, which can be recovered from the lax colimit by a suitable localization. However, lax colimits do not provide the correct notion of gluing from the geometric perspective. Indeed, they are incompatible with the notion of categorical dimension, the Gray tensor product, and other basic geometric operations.
